comment: The section says that components in the first layer may be reusable “potentially across sectors,” but the Lifelong Health Record and health-specific terminology and information models are primarily health-sector resources. Cross-sector reusability is therefore not a reliable inclusion criterion for the entire layer.

public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish between components reused across health programmes and components potentially reused across sectors. Make cross-programme reuse the minimum criterion for DPI-H and cross-sector reuse an additional characteristic where applicable.
